collection.title: Skoda Octavia Hatchback 2012 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Skoda Octavia Hatchback Mk3 2012 - 2018 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Slim Push Button arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Skoda Octavia, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
